description: This course prepares McNair Scholars for the rigors of academic writing. The enrolled students
represent a variety of disciplines, so this course is not meant to replace discipline-specific
research methods or writing courses. Students review disciplinary scholarly literature, prepare a
formal poster presentation, practice communicating their work to different audiences, explore the
historical and social contexts of academic writing, and reflect on their own summer experience.
Offered every summer. Prerequisite: successful completion of Writing and Rhetoric.
fullname: McNair Research Writing Across the Disciplines
